title: Ox Passion Berries Burst Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Salts Berries Burst is a vibrant medley of ripe, juicy berries, blending the sweetness of summer fruits with a crisp, tangy edge. This bold fruit fusion delivers a rush of bright berry flavour on the inhale, followed by a refreshingly tart finish for a perfectly balanced vape. Blended in a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, offering smooth nicotine delivery, full-bodied flavour, and discreet vapour production. Perfect for pod vape kits and starter devices, it ensures rapid nicotine absorption and a consistently satisfying experience. Developed by Oxva, a trusted name in vaping technology, the OX Passion Salts range brings expertly crafted flavours designed to pair seamlessly with Oxva’s XLIM pod kits and other refillable vape devices.
